text:
Tess: Quick announce: docs CI will run inline code snippets with a 5s execution cap starting next week. Please check your PRs.

Omar: Is that global for all docs or only certain paths?

Tess: Only markdown under docs/ that gets executed by snippet-checker. Sample apps and the hosted playground are excluded.

Zane: Any recommended patterns for examples that need longer runtime?

Tess: Options: (1) shorten example to fit 5s, (2) show mocked output, (3) move long-run demo to sample-apps and link to it. We'll add examples in CONTRIBUTING.md.

docs-bot: Automation note: snippet-checker will use --timeout=5s for docs/**. Failing snippets trigger an automated comment with guidance. See internal doc: https://go.redwood/ci-snippet-timeout :robot_face:

Omar: Will update the PR template and CONTRIBUTING checklist.

Tess: Rollout: staging enforcement Mon, main enforcement Wed (dates in internal calendar). We'll revisit after one week. Ping me for exceptions.

Zane: Thanks — I'll prep a short migration guide with sample diffs.
